lines.en: label ayanesanabeach2:
scene sanaatthebeach1
: Yo.
: Figured I’d come say hi since you’ve been all by yourself this whole time.
lines.zh: : 想着过来打个招呼，毕竟你这一整晚都一个人待着。

lines.en: : Sana?
lines.zh: : Sana？

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach2
: Oh...yeah. Sorry. I just...
lines.zh: : 哦……嗯。抱歉。我只是……

lines.en: : I wasn’t expecting you, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我没想到你会来。

lines.en: : I figured you’d be staying with Ayane until it came time for us to leave.
lines.zh: : 我以为你会一直陪着 Ayane，直到我们该走了。

lines.en: : And I figured you would have joined us at some point, but...here we are.
lines.zh: : 而我还以为你迟早会过来找我们，结果……我们俩就在这儿了。

lines.en: : Here we are...
lines.zh: : 就在这儿了……

lines.en: : Is this really how you wanted to spend your day? Alone under a tree while Ayane and I hung out without you?
lines.zh: : 你今天真的就想这么过？一个人待在树下，看着我和 Ayane 撇下你玩？

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach1
: It beats getting killed by the sun, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少总比被太阳晒死强。

lines.en: : Besides, I’d just be getting in the way if I came and joined you two. Even if...it was supposed to just be Ayane and me today.
lines.zh: : 再说，我要是过去加入你们，也只是碍事而已。尽管……今天本来该是只有我和 Ayane 两个人的。

lines.en: : Uh-oh. Did I interrupt your romantic getaway with your roommate?
lines.zh: : 哦豁。我该不会是打断了你和你室友的浪漫二人世界吧？

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach3
: Mhm. Do you really think I’d ever wear something like this for {i}you?{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。你真觉得我会为了{i}你{/i}穿成这样？

lines.en: : Crazy. All this time and I had no idea you felt that way about her. Does Ayane know?
lines.zh: : 疯了。这么久以来我居然完全不知道你对她是这种感觉。Ayane 知道吗？

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach4
: Of course. She’s the one who invited me after all.
lines.zh: : 当然。毕竟是她邀请我来的。

lines.en: : But I suppose I’ll always be second to you, Sensei. If only she and I went back as far as you two. Maybe then I’d have a real chance.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，在你心里我永远是第二位的吧，Sensei。要是她和我能像你们俩那样早就认识，也许我还能有点真正的机会。

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach5
: But, that aside...I’m glad the sun is finally gone. At long last, I can feel my energy returning little by little.
lines.zh: : 不过，撇开这个不谈……我很高兴太阳终于下山了。总算，我能感觉到自己的精力一点一点回来了。

lines.en: : Kudos to me for managing to both stay out of harm’s way {i}and{/i} give you and Ayane all of the private time you needed.
lines.zh: : 真该给自己鼓个掌——既躲开了危险，{i}又{/i}把你们俩需要的独处时间全数奉上。

lines.en: : Kudos to you, indeed. But there’s no need to bring up Ayane anymore when it’s time for the two of {i}us{/i} to have some “private time” now.
lines.zh: : 确实该给你鼓掌。不过现在轮到{i}我们两个{/i}独处了，就没必要再提 Ayane 了吧。

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach6
: And what would you like to do with that “private time” I wonder?
lines.zh: : 那我倒想知道，你想用这段“独处时间”做点什么？

lines.en: : That entirely depends on how much I am allowed to do.
lines.zh: : 那完全取决于我被允许做到哪一步。

lines.en: : I don’t remember setting any guidelines or rules for you to follow.
lines.zh: : 我不记得给你定过什么准则或规矩要你遵守。

lines.en: : Maybe not directly. But you’ve inadvertently set a bunch of unspoken ones throughout the brief time we’ve known one another.
lines.zh: : 也许没有明说。但在我们认识的这短短时间里，你无意中立下了一大堆不成文的规矩。

lines.en: : Have I?
lines.zh: : 有吗？

lines.en: : You have.
: Name one.
lines.zh: : 说一条来听听。

lines.en: : Remember that time you passed out because I held your hand while you weren't looking?
lines.zh: : 还记得那次我趁你没注意牵了你的手，结果你直接昏过去了？

lines.en: : Doesn’t ring a bell.
lines.zh: : 没印象。

lines.en: : Or all of those times you told me you only looked at me as a teacher?
lines.zh: : 或者那些次你告诉我，你只把我当老师看？

lines.en: : Are you something more than that?
lines.zh: : 那你还算别的什么吗？

lines.en: : You tell me. I have no idea what to make of this...weird mood you’re in right now.
lines.zh: : 你告诉我啊。我真不知道该怎么理解你眼下这种……奇怪的状态。

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach7
: Weird?...
: Yeah. Did that swimsuit unlock some sort of secret power or something? Because you’ve seemed a lot less...Sana than normal tonight.
lines.zh: : 对。那件泳衣是不是解锁了什么隐藏能力之类的？因为今晚你看起来比平时……不太像 Sana。

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach8
: I’m...the same {i}Sana{/i} as always, though.
lines.zh: : 可我……还是一直以来的那个 {i}Sana{/i} 啊。

lines.en: : I guess I’m just a little excited that you decided to spend time with {i}me...{/i}that’s all.
lines.zh: : 我想，我只是有点开心你决定来陪{i}我{/i}……就这样。

lines.en: : That stuff about being worried about bothering you and Ayane...it’s all I could think of over here.
lines.zh: : 至于担心打扰你和 Ayane 那些话……我在这儿满脑子就想着这些。

lines.en: : I wanted to see you. I wanted to see you {i}so{/i} badly. But you belong to her and I belong to-
lines.zh: : 我想见你。我{i}特别{/i}特别想见你。可你属于她，而我属于——

lines.en: : I don’t belong to anyone.
lines.zh: : 我不属于任何人。

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach9
: Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : Why not belong to {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 为什么不属于{i}我{/i}呢？

lines.en: : I’m sorry?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Am I not good enough?
lines.zh: : 是我不够好吗？

lines.en: : Am I too small?
lines.zh: : 是我太小了吗？

lines.en: : Is someone like Ayane or my mom better suited to your interests?
lines.zh: : 还是说，像 Ayane 或者我妈妈那样的人更符合你的兴趣？

lines.en: : What’s...going on with you right now?
lines.zh: : 你……现在这是怎么了？

lines.en: : Maybe I’ve been drinking? I was just saying the other day that I talk too much when I drink, wasn’t I?
lines.zh: : 也许我喝醉了？我前两天不是还说，我一喝酒话就特别多吗？

lines.en: : You were...but I don’t see any alcohol laying around.
lines.zh: : 你是说过……可我没看见周围有酒啊。

lines.en: : Heat stroke, then? That makes people act all sorts of weird, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那是中暑了？中暑会让人做出各种奇怪的举动，不是吗？

lines.en: : It does, but...
lines.zh: : 是会，不过……

lines.en: : Why does it even matter? It’s just the two of {i}us{/i} now...so you shouldn’t be worrying about something as silly as why I’m acting the way I am if the way I’m acting is {i}good.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那又有什么关系呢？现在就{i}我们两个{/i}……所以如果我现在这副样子是{i}好的{/i}，你就不该去纠结“我为什么是这副样子”这种蠢问题。

lines.en: : Enjoy the moment, Sensei. We don’t get many of them.
lines.zh: : 享受当下吧，Sensei。这种时刻我们可不多。

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach10
: Though...
lines.zh: : 不过……

lines.en: : I really wish we did.
lines.zh: : 我真的希望我们能多有一点。

lines.en: : I get lonely...just like every other girl.
lines.zh: : 我会寂寞……跟其他所有女孩一样。

lines.en: : There are things I want. Things I want that everyone else gets to have while I sit in the background. Unremarkable and exceedingly average.
lines.zh: : 有我想要的东西。那些东西别人都能拥有，而我只能坐在背景里。不起眼，而且平庸得过分。

lines.en: : I don’t want to be average anymore. I want to be fun. Exciting. Someone like Ayane or...or Rin.
lines.zh: : 我不想再平庸了。我想变得有趣。刺激。像 Ayane 那样，或者……或者 Rin 那样。

lines.en: : People who can talk to you without getting nervous or scared or worried or-
lines.zh: : 那种能跟你说话而不会紧张、不会害怕、不会担心，不会——

lines.en: : But that’s not you.
lines.zh: : 可那不是你。

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach3
: What do you know about who I am?
lines.zh: : 你又知道我是怎样的人？

lines.en: : Only what you’ve taught me over the last...five or six semesters.
lines.zh: : 只限于你在这……五六个学期里教给我的那些。

lines.en: : I can teach you more, you know.
lines.zh: : 我可以教你更多啊，你知道的。

lines.en: : There are tons of things about me I’m keeping locked away. And there are only so many places I can hide the key.
lines.zh: : 关于我，还有一大堆东西被我锁着呢。而能藏钥匙的地方，也就那么几个。

lines.en: : You’re not going to question how we’ve been together for five or six semesters despite still being a first year?
lines.zh: : 你就不好奇吗——我们明明还只是一年级，却已经在一起五六个学期了？

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach11
: Oh! Uhh...has it been that many already? It feels like just yesterday we were meeting one another and-
lines.zh: : 哦！呃……已经那么久了吗？感觉我们才刚认识，明明就像昨天——

lines.en: : Who are you?
lines.zh: : 你是谁？

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach12
: Sana Sakakibara...part time bartender and full time student. Resident of...dorm number two. Ayane’s best friend. A...member of the light music club.
lines.zh: : Sana Sakakibara……兼职调酒师，全职学生。住在……2 号宿舍。Ayane 最好的朋友。轻音部的……成员。

lines.en: : A girl who...really likes you and...is having a really hard time accepting that?
lines.zh: : 一个……真的很喜欢你、而且……很难接受这件事的女孩。

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach13
: Oh, God damn it.
lines.zh: : 噢，该死。

lines.en: scene colorbars
scene happy1
scene sanaatthebeach14
: You know, you’re a real buzzkill. A girl you’ve been chasing after to no avail for [totaldays] days is finally starting to open up to you and you go and do {i}this?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，你真是个扫兴大王。一个你追了 [totaldays] 天都没追到的女孩，好不容易开始对你敞开心扉了，你偏要来{i}这一出{/i}？

lines.en: : You...
: You’re the girl from...
lines.zh: : 你是那个从……

lines.en: : From...
: Where do I know you from?
lines.zh: : 我在哪儿见过你？

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach15
: I’m surprised you know me {i}at all.{/i} Those memories aren’t supposed to stick.
lines.zh: : 你{i}居然{/i}还记得我，真让我意外。那些记忆本该是留不住的。

lines.en: : What memories? How do you know what is and isn’t supposed to stick? And how were you Sana just now?
lines.zh: : 什么记忆？你怎么知道什么该留住、什么不该留住？还有，你刚才怎么变成 Sana 的？

lines.en: : So many questions. You must be {i}really{/i} confused, huh?
lines.zh: : 问题真多。你一定{i}很{/i}困惑吧？

lines.en: : Can you blame me? It’s not every day someone I know transforms into someone else.
lines.zh: : 能怪我吗？我认识的人变成另一个人，这种事又不是天天有。

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach16
: Hey, hey, hey! How can you be so sure of that? That Ami girl is {i}really{/i} suspicious at times, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : 嘿，嘿，嘿！你怎么能这么肯定？那个叫 Ami 的姑娘有时候也{i}相当{/i}可疑，不是吗？

lines.en: : And what about Niki? A convenient childhood friend slash ex-girlfriend who’s also an idol that never gave up on you after all of those years away? Get real.
lines.zh: : 还有 Niki 呢？一个方便得不能再方便的青梅竹马兼前女友，还是个偶像，在你离开那么多年之后都没放弃你？得了吧。

lines.en: : There’s tons of weird stuff that happens to you.
lines.zh: : 发生在你身上的怪事多着呢。

lines.en: : If I were you and {i}I{/i} were going to go hunting for shapeshifters, those two are where I would start. Not the short, quiet girl with unsightly habits.
lines.zh: : 如果我是你，要去找出变形者的话，{i}我{/i}会先从那两个开始。而不是一个矮矮的、安静的、还有点不良习惯的姑娘。

lines.en: : Unsightly habits? What are-
lines.zh: : 不良习惯？什么——

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach17
: But enough about that! Let’s talk about my amazing impression and how awesome I am!
lines.zh: : 不过那个先不说了！来聊聊我精彩的模仿、以及我有多厉害吧！

lines.en: : Hooray! Clap clap clap clap clap.
lines.zh: : 好耶！啪啪啪啪啪。

lines.en: : I don’t want it to sound like I’m encouraging this since I’d prefer if you stayed {i}out{/i} of my students’ bodies, but...you should probably talk a little slower the next time you slip into Sana’s.
lines.zh: : 我可不想听起来像是在鼓励你，毕竟我还是希望你{i}别{/i}再钻进我学生的身体里了，不过……下次你要是再钻进 Sana 的身体，最好说得慢一点。

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach18
: First off, rude.
lines.zh: : 首先，你真失礼。

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach19
: Second, I didn’t {i}slip{/i} into anyone’s body. I’ve been me the whole time.
lines.zh: : 其次，我没有{i}钻进{/i}任何人的身体。我从头到尾都是我自己。

lines.en: : You saw Sana because that’s what you wanted to see. And you stopped seeing her the moment you realized you were never seeing her at all.
lines.zh: : 你看见了 Sana，因为那就是你想看见的。而当你在意识到自己压根就没在看着她时，你就不再看见她了。

lines.en: : The human mind is interesting...how it can be tricked into seeing or feeling certain things that aren’t there.
lines.zh: : 人类的心智真有意思……它是怎么被哄骗着去看见或感受某些根本不存在的东西。

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach20
: But I guess that maybe I {i}do{/i} take a little advantage of that from time to time.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，我大概偶尔也{i}确实{/i}会小小地利用一下这点。

lines.en: : It’s not every day that I get to talk to somebody, you know. Gotta seize the opportunity when the opportunity arises.
lines.zh: : 毕竟不是每天都有人能跟我说上话，你知道吧。机会来了就得抓住。

lines.en: : Can you tell me...literally anything of value? Who you are? Why you’re here? Where Sana is?
lines.zh: : 你能不能告诉我……任何有价值的东西？你是谁？你为什么在这儿？Sana 在哪儿？

lines.en: : Sana’s just a little further down the shoreline. Good luck trying to talk to her right now, though.
lines.zh: : Sana 就在海岸线再往前一点的地方。不过你现在想跟她说话，祝你好运。

lines.en: : As for the other two questions...I’m sorry, but I can’t answer them.
lines.zh: : 至于另外两个问题……抱歉，我不能回答。

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么不能？

lines.en: : Because I can’t.
lines.zh: : 因为我不能。

lines.en: : That’s not a very good answer.
lines.zh: : 这算什么回答。

lines.en: : Hey, I don’t make the rules. In fact, I rarely ever even follow them. Which I guess inadvertently answers question numero dos but, in case anyone asks, that was totally off the record.
lines.zh: : 嘿，规矩又不是我定的。事实上我连遵守都很少遵守。这大概顺带回答了你的第二个问题，不过万一有人问起来，刚才那句完全是私下闲聊。

lines.en: : Any vague hints pertaining to {i}who{/i} you are?
lines.zh: : 关于你是{i}谁{/i}，能给点模糊的提示吗？

lines.en: : Wanna take a guess?
lines.zh: : 想猜猜看吗？

lines.en: : Are you...
lines.zh: : 你是……

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach21
: Woohoo! You got it-
lines.zh: : 哇哦！答对了——

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach22
: Completely and utterly wrong. Not even close. 0/10.
lines.zh: : 完完全全、彻彻底底地答错了。差了十万八千里。零分。

lines.en: : Well, then...do you have anything to do with the weird shit going on in this world? Assuming you {i}know{/i} about the weird shit going on in this world, that is.
lines.zh: : 那么……你跟这个世界正在发生的那些怪事有关系吗？当然，前提是你{i}知道{/i}这个世界正在发生怪事。

lines.en: : Again, that’s not really something I can answer. But you’ve gotta say, it’d be pretty gosh darn weird if I wasn’t {i}somehow{/i} involved, right?
lines.zh: : 再说一次，这真不是我能回答的。不过你不得不承认，如果我没有{i}以某种方式{/i}牵涉其中，那可就太他妈奇怪了，对吧？

lines.en: : Showing up out of nowhere...passing as a mimic...I wager I’m probably the most suspicious person you’ve ever met.
lines.zh: : 凭空冒出来……伪装成拟态者……我敢打赌，我大概是你见过的最可疑的人了。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t say you {i}passed,{/i} by the way. Your impression was still miles off.
lines.zh: : 顺带一提，我可不觉得你伪装{i}成功{/i}了。你的模仿还是差得远。

lines.en: : But I guess expecting anyone to be able to understand Sana without putting in the effort to actually get to {i}know{/i} her is just...not likely.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，指望有人不用花心思真正去{i}了解{/i} Sana 就能懂她，那本来……就不太可能。

lines.en: : Are you insinuating something there, buddy?
lines.zh: : 你这是在暗示什么吗，老兄？

lines.en: : Just that it’s a little rude to make up someone’s feelings.
lines.zh: : 只是觉得，凭空编造别人的感情有点失礼。

lines.en: : I wasn’t making them up. I was just...
lines.zh: : 我没有编造。我只是……

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach23
: ...Appropriating them?
lines.zh: : ……借用了一下？

lines.en: : Channeling her energy?
lines.zh: : 传导了一下她的能量？

lines.en: : Are you a psychic now, too?
lines.zh: : 那你现在还是个通灵师了？

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach24
: Nope! And I’m very thankful for that as the idea of being able to read {i}your{/i} mind gives me the heebie-jeebies.
lines.zh: : 不是！而且我对此感激不尽——一想到能读{i}你{/i}的心，我就浑身起鸡皮疙瘩。

lines.en: : I am also thankful that you can’t read my mind right about now.
lines.zh: : 我也很庆幸这会儿你读不了我的心。

lines.en: : Keep it in your pants, chief. I’m not that kind of character.
lines.zh: : 把裤子穿好，老大。我不是那种角色。

lines.en: : Even though you were only a step or two away from seducing me using Sana’s appearance?
lines.zh: : 尽管你刚才离用 Sana 的外表勾引我就差一两步了？

lines.en: : Hey, I obviously would have backed down before it went anywhere. I just wanted to see how long I could mess with you before you snapped out of it.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我显然会在事情发展到那一步之前收手的。我只是想看看，在你清醒过来之前，我能耍你多久。

lines.en: : Snapped out of what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 清醒过来？从什么里清醒过来？

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: Another one of your thingamajigs.
lines.zh: : 又是你的那些小状况之一。

lines.en: : You walked off to find Sana and, somewhere along the way, your mind went blank.
lines.zh: : 你走开去找 Sana，然后在半路上，你的脑子一片空白。

lines.en: : Thankfully, I was close by when it happened.  So I got to see the whole thing.
lines.zh: : 幸好事发时我就在附近。所以我全程都看到了。

lines.en: : I’m...blacking out right now?
lines.zh: : 我现在……是在断片？

lines.en: : Mmm...not quite. In fact, I’m not really sure what’s going on- what with you vaguely remembering me and being able to hold an actual conversation in your current state.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也不完全是。事实上我也不太确定到底怎么回事——你居然模模糊糊记得我，还能在你现在这种状态下真的跟我对话。

lines.en: : Maybe you’re just getting a little better at being crazy?
lines.zh: : 也许你只是在发疯这件事上越来越熟练了？

lines.en: : Wow. What a fun and useful skill to have.
lines.zh: : 哇。这可真是个又好玩又有用的技能。

lines.en: : Yeah. Not many practical uses for that, are there?
lines.zh: : 是啊。这技能也没什么实际用途，对吧？

lines.en: : Why can’t {i}I{/i} transform into other people? I want that instead.
lines.zh: : 为什么{i}我{/i}就不能变成别人？我倒想要那个。

lines.en: : You can!
lines.zh: : 你能啊！

lines.en: : You just do it in a different way than me.
lines.zh: : 只不过你变的方式跟我不同。

lines.en: : Think of how many yous there are. How many yous there have {i}been.{/i} Each one entirely different from the last.
lines.zh: : 想想看，有多少个你。{i}曾经有过{/i}多少个你。每一个都和上一个完全不同。

lines.en: : And think of how many yous there could be at this current moment! Grooming teenage girls in parallel universes...plunging life itself into a lecherous, endless bout of chaos!
lines.zh: : 再想想，此时此刻又可能存在着多少个你！在平行宇宙里诱导女高中生……把生命本身推进一场好色的、无止境的混乱里！

lines.en: : There are just so many possibilities!
lines.zh: : 可能性就是这么多啊！

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach25
: And yet you have found yourself in {i}this{/i} timeline...where everything is bad and good all at once.
lines.zh: : 然而你却发现自己落在了{i}这条{/i}时间线上……在这里，一切同时既糟糕又美好。

lines.en: : Where time moves both backward and forward simultaneously...just like {i}Ayane{/i} said.
lines.zh: : 在这里，时间同时向前和向后流动……就像 {i}Ayane{/i} 说的那样。

lines.en: : If that was even her speaking. I’m not sure who I can trust anymore knowing that you can just...become other people.
lines.zh: : 如果那真是她本人说的话。知道你能随随便便……变成别人，我已经不确定还能信谁了。

lines.en: : Thankfully, that’s a worry you won’t have to live with for long since you will {i}probably{/i} forget me again after tonight.
lines.zh: : 谢天谢地，这份烦恼你不用背太久，因为今晚过后你{i}大概{/i}就又把我忘了。

lines.en: : I’ll never turn into {i}her,{/i} though.
lines.zh: : 不过我永远不会变成{i}她{/i}。

lines.en: : And I know it’s pointless to say this since I literally {i}just{/i} told you you're going to forget, but...try and remember that.
lines.zh: : 我也知道说这个没意义，因为我{i}刚刚{/i}才告诉你你会忘掉，但……尽量记住这个。

lines.en: : Why won't you turn into Ayane?
lines.zh: : 为什么你不会变成 Ayane？

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach26
: Don’t wanna.
lines.zh: : 不想。

lines.en: : Don’t like feeling what she feels.
lines.zh: : 不喜欢感受她的感受。

lines.en: : Also, don’t make it sound like doing what I did tonight is some sort of hobby for me. I normally just try on their clothes. Very rarely do I feel the need to step in and start playing charades.
lines.zh: : 另外，别把今晚我做的事说得像是什么爱好。我平常只是试穿她们的衣服。极少会有需要我亲自上场演戏的时候。

lines.en: : Maybe...don’t do that at all anymore.
lines.zh: : 也许……以后干脆别做这种事了。

lines.en: : Going to have a hard time looking at Sana now that you know how she really feels about you? Or is that something you’ve known all along?
lines.zh: : 现在知道她对你的真实感受了，以后再见 Sana 会很难受吧？还是说这事你一直都知道？

lines.en: scene sanaatthebeach27
: I won’t know anything for sure until {i}she{/i} tells me. Hearing her feelings fall out of someone else’s throat just isn’t enough.
lines.zh: : 在{i}她{/i}亲口告诉我之前，我什么都确定不了。听着她的感情从别人的喉咙里掉出来，是不够的。

lines.en: : But you have your suspicions, of course.
lines.zh: : 不过你心里肯定有猜测吧。

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : Everyone loves me.
lines.zh: : 每个人都爱我。

lines.en: : They have to.
lines.zh: : 她们必须爱我。

lines.en: : Do they?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : The world was made for me.
lines.zh: : 这个世界是为我而造的。

lines.en: : Was it?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: scene happy1
scene sanaatthebeach28
: Is that what you really believe? Or is that what you {i}want{/i} to believe?
lines.zh: : 这真的是你所相信的吗？还是你{i}希望{/i}自己相信的？

lines.en: : It’s the only thing that makes sense.
lines.zh: : 这是唯一说得通的解释。

lines.en: : You talk to birds. You are no authority on what does and doesn’t make sense.
lines.zh: : 你还会跟鸟说话。你在“什么说得通”这件事上可算不上权威。

lines.en: : Are you?
lines.zh: : 那你是？

lines.en: scene happy1
scene sanaatthebeach29
: No.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : In many respects, I’m just as lost as you are.
lines.zh: : 在很多方面，我跟你一样迷茫。

lines.en: : I just got a little lucky and skipped living through the whole “infinite high school” thing.
lines.zh: : 我只是稍微走了点运，跳过了“无限高中”那一段。

lines.en: : You get used to it. I’m not really complaining.
lines.zh: : 你会习惯的。我也没在抱怨什么。

lines.en: : Why would you? Your life is great.
lines.zh: : 你干嘛要抱怨？你的人生棒极了。

lines.en: : And yours isn’t?
lines.zh: : 你的不是吗？

lines.en: : It will be.
lines.zh: : 会是的。

lines.en: : Some day.
lines.zh: : 总有一天。

lines.en: scene happy1
scene sanaatthebeach30
: I hope that day comes soon.
lines.zh: : 我希望那一天快点来。

lines.en: : You’re kind of annoying and I feel like you can definitely tell me more than what you actually have, but...
lines.zh: : 你挺烦人的，而且我觉得你明明能告诉我的远不止你说的这些，不过……

lines.en: : I don’t hate you or anything.
lines.zh: : 我也不讨厌你什么的。

lines.en: : I’m glad.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴。

lines.en: : I don’t hate you either.
lines.zh: : 我也不讨厌你。

lines.en: : I think we have to say goodbye now.
lines.zh: : 我想我们得说再见了。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : I’m not going to remember you...right?
lines.zh: : 我不会记得你的……对吧？

lines.en: : Probably not.
lines.zh: : 大概不会。

lines.en: : Then, for the sake of ending this extremely weird conversation on a good note...can you tell me your name?
lines.zh: : 那么，为了让这场极其怪异的对话能有个好点的收尾……能告诉我你的名字吗？

lines.en: : Why don’t you give me one?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不给我取一个？

lines.en: : {i}Give{/i} you one?
lines.zh: : {i}给{/i}你取一个？

lines.en: : I have no idea where I’d even start.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道该从哪儿开始。

lines.en: : I don’t know anything about you other than the fact that you have nice eyes and...occasionally  someone {i}else’s{/i} eyes instead.
lines.zh: : 我对你一无所知，只知道你有一双好看的眼睛……以及偶尔换成了{i}别人{/i}的眼睛。

lines.en: : Would you like a suggestion?
lines.zh: : 要不要我给点建议？

lines.en: : It would certainly be appreciated.
lines.zh: : 那当然感激不尽。

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: scene black
: Name me after your favorite flower.
lines.zh: : 用你最喜欢的花给我命名。
